about_the_game:
In this demo, lead lovable possum boy Joey Virginia through the first few weeks of his college career!

The year is 2019, and Joey Virginia is a perfectly average young man leaving home for his first semester at college. Except he's half opossum! And he's the only animal person around! In this romantic comedy visual novel, you'll help Joey find friendship, find himself, and maybe even find love! Play the full game to experience all sorts of fun college adventures alongside Joey:

  • Study for class!

  • Play tabletop role-playing games!

  • Act in a student film!

  • Do some nude modeling!

  • Cry at a party!

  • Potentially date one of six different cuties!

  • Unlock a mysterious secret ending...?

  • AND MUCH, MUCH MORE!
